title: Words Over the Camera
hook_vo: Put your lyrics over a live camera, in OBS or a switcher.

beats.vo: Add a screen, and send it over the network instead of to a monitor.
Make it transparent, and turn the background off.
In OBS, pick the stream, and the words sit over the camera.
For a switcher, fill and key go out of one Blackmagic device.
